name: Campbell's - Milwaukee WI
type: Manufacturing - spice production (Campbell Soup Supply Co.)

fieldNotes.identity: Roster address (445 South 32nd Street) and roster coords are wrong - they land in a residential Milwaukee neighborhood. The Campbell's Milwaukee facility is the Campbell Soup Supply Co. spice plant at 500 W Edgerton Ave, Milwaukee WI 53207, operating since 1966 as Campbell's only US spice operation. OSM confirms the building and company at 42.95258,-87.91817; satellite shows a brick/white industrial building with heavy rooftop process silos/tanks. Locked center 42.9525,-87.9182.
fieldNotes.truckGate: The site has chain-link perimeter fencing along the W Edgerton frontage, but the single driveway from W Edgerton Ave appears OPEN (no barrier arm, no closed sliding/swing gate panel, no guard booth) in 2025 Street View and z21 satellite. STOP/wrong-way signage at the throat but no physical control. Called truckGate=false (open driveway despite perimeter fence) - medium confidence; a swing gate could be present and held open.
fieldNotes.guardShack: No booth structure at the driveway entrance.
fieldNotes.drivewayLong: Driveway runs a long straight ~80m from W Edgerton Ave to the building, through the parking lot to the W truck yard - holds 3+ trucks.
fieldNotes.dockDoors: Modest loading on the W building face; Street View shows a prominent 'TM TRUCK' overhead door plus adjacent doors. A specialized spice plant - estimated 4-8 dock/overhead doors -> 0-10 band. Low confidence on exact count.
fieldNotes.dropArea: No marked trailer-parking stalls with parked trailers; the W yard is a paved process/maneuvering area. dropArea NONE, dropYard false.
fieldNotes.entryExitTogether: Single driveway serves entry and exit.
fieldNotes.urbanRural: Dense Milwaukee industrial district immediately west of General Mitchell International Airport - Urban.
fieldNotes.railServed: No rail spur runs into the property; a rail corridor exists in the broader district but not onto this parcel.
